source_edb: D:/Thesis/Etabs/NBC Ultimate/Ultimate Belt truss, outrigger and cap truss 6 m/ULTIMATE LOAD  - NEPAL - 23 - BELT TRUSS, OUTRIGGER CAP TRUSS - Copy.EDB
scope: frame/area property and load audit; the forceBeamColumn export is not a complete gravity or mass model
warning: Review API return order, units, local axes, section dimensions and material properties before using them.

load_code_basis.primary: Applicable Nepal National Building Codes; NBC 105:2025 §§3.6-3.7 for combinations and NBC 105:2025 §5.2/Table 5-1 for seismic weight.
load_code_basis.fallback: Where the applicable Nepal standard is silent, use relevant Indian Standards and record the exact standard/clause and project assumption.
load_code_basis.indian_load_references: IS 875 Part 1 for dead-load unit weights; IS 875 Part 2 for imposed loads; use Nepal seismic combination rules where NBC 105 governs.

load_combination_policy: ETABS reference loads remain unfactored and separate by pattern. NBC 105:2025 §3.6 LSM combinations are applied to response combinations; §3.7 WSM combinations are excluded from this workflow. Do not place 1.2/1.5 factors inside imported source loads or scale NLTHA ground motion.

self_weight_and_load_coverage.beam: Not auto-added by this forceBeamColumn exporter; derive from verified section area and material unit weight only if ETABS DL excludes self-weight.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.column: Not auto-added; same duplicate-self-weight check required. For vertical members gravity is axial in local x; OpenSees 3D beamUniform argument order is Wy, Wz, Wx.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.shear_wall: Area property/load audit only; wall element, self-weight, and transferred area loads are not instantiated.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.slab: Area property/load audit only; no slab shell or validated tributary transfer to beams/walls is instantiated.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.brace: Connectivity can be audited as a frame, but physical steel self-weight must use verified brace area/unit weight and be applied once.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.FVD: Device/link element and self-weight are not generated; use manufacturer/ETABS device weight and explicit end nodes.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.BRB: Device/brace element and self-weight are not generated; do not infer weight from core yield strength; use verified physical area/unit weight or ETABS dead load.
self_weight_and_load_coverage.mass: NBC seismic mass factors are recorded in the NBC settings; complete nodal mass assignment is not generated here.
